acceptanceCriteria: The command runs once per change, not per tick.
A failing hook becomes a finding and never blocks the dispatcher.
It is bounded by a timeout and an output cap.
An identical finding set never notifies twice.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1044 (opened 2026-10-17). Feature request; not yet specified. Problem The only way to be told that findings changed is a polling script that diffs the summary and sends a desktop notification. Current workaround A loop runs every 15 minutes, builds an issue list from status and doctor output, and notifies only when the list changes. Proposal A `notify {command, minIntervalSeconds}` setting in doctor or service config runs an adopter-supplied argv with the new finding summary on stdin, only when the finding set changes, under the plugin sandbox rules. See beamfall/corvint#1044 for the full text.
title: doctor/service: notify hook when the finding set changes (issue #1044)
